# Contract: `config/subscriptions.auto.tfvars`

**Owner**: operator (regenerated by `bootstrap.ps1`) | **Consumer**: `infra/` OpenTofu root | **Reload**: per `tofu plan`

This file declares the subscription "slots" the platform knows about. Each slot corresponds to one static `provider "azurerm"` block in `infra/providers.tf`. Spokes reference slots by name.

## HCL shape

```hcl
subscription_slots = {
  "<slot_name>" = {
    subscription_id = "<subscription_guid>"
  }
}
```

## Field-by-field contract

### `<slot_name>` (map key)

- **Type**: string
- **Required**: yes
- **Pattern**: `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$` — lowercase, underscores allowed (Terraform alias rules). Must match the suffix of a `provider "azurerm" { alias = "sub_<slot_name>" }` block in `infra/providers.tf`.
- **Reserved name**: `hub` — required to exist and must match `platform.hub_subscription_id`.

### `subscription_id`

- **Type**: string (GUID)
- **Required**: yes
- **Validation**: the deployment SP must hold `Contributor` and `User Access Administrator` at `/subscriptions/<this id>` scope before plan can succeed. `bootstrap.ps1` ensures this.

## Sourcing

`bootstrap.ps1` writes the canonical version of this file to `bootstrap/outputs/discovered.auto.tfvars.json` based on `az account list`. The operator copies the relevant entries into `config/subscriptions.auto.tfvars` (HCL form) and edits `infra/providers.tf` to add a matching alias block for any new slot.

## Worked example

```hcl
subscription_slots = {
  hub    = { subscription_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111" }
  demo_a = { subscription_id = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222" }
}
```

Matching `infra/providers.tf` (sketch — concrete `features {}` and `client_id` come from variables / env):

```hcl
provider "azurerm" {
  alias           = "sub_hub"
  subscription_id = var.subscription_slots["hub"].subscription_id
  features {}
  use_oidc = true
  # ...
}

provider "azurerm" {
  alias           = "sub_demo_a"
  subscription_id = var.subscription_slots["demo_a"].subscription_id
  features {}
  use_oidc = true
  # ...
}
```

## When this file changes

- **New subscription introduced**: add a new `subscription_slots` entry **and** add a matching `provider "azurerm" { alias = "sub_<name>" }` block. One-time HCL edit per subscription.
- **Existing subscription used for new spoke**: no change to this file; only `spokes.auto.tfvars` changes.
- **Subscription decommissioned**: remove its entry from this file **and** delete the matching provider alias block. All spokes in that subscription must be deleted from `spokes.auto.tfvars` first, in a prior PR.
